decision_summary: Visionary, Builder, and Guardian approve v0.6.38 Route Policy Drift and Revalidation with immutable-history boundaries.
rationale: The slice closes policy-version drift after decision and adjudication while preserving historical authority, forbidding automatic mutation, and routing stale or uncertain applicability to governance.
recommendation: Implement the narrow calibration-report extension and release only after retained negative fixtures, full QIF verification, self-review, and retrospective.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, operators, governance owners, and affected stakeholders
expected_user_reaction: Users can see which policy governed a decision, exactly what changed, whether the decision became stale, and what revalidation did.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add route-policy snapshots, policy changes, drift assessments, revalidation outcomes and assessments, examples, verifier rules, fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, and release evidence.
